verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented way to connect an external coding agent so it drives v0's builder alongside or instead of v0's own agent: no MCP server, agent connector or bring-your-own-agent mode. The Platform API and SDK give programmatic access to v0's own AI generation and custom chat UIs. GitHub sync lets outside tools push code to the repo. Both are developer building blocks or workarounds, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect my own coding agent to the project so it drives the builder alongside or instead of the built-in one
